name: 53051 · Menomonee Fls, WI
findings: ZIP 53051 (Menomonee Fls) has 144 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53051 (Menomonee Fls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
